```{r}
#| label: setup
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
source(file.path("..", "Figure_Data", "FigureABM.R"))

R0_VALUES <- c(5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17)
MATRICES  <- c(POLYMOD = "../scenarios", "Epistorm-Mix" = ".")

fmt <- function(x) formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
```

```{r}
#| label: data
sizes <- rbindlist(lapply(names(MATRICES), function(m) {
  rbindlist(lapply(R0_VALUES, function(r0) {
    s <- abm_summaries(MATRICES[[m]], r0, epistorm = m == "Epistorm-Mix")
    s$final[,
      .(
        median = median(outbreak_size),
        q25    = quantile(outbreak_size, 0.25, names = FALSE),
        q75    = quantile(outbreak_size, 0.75, names = FALSE)
      ),
      by = scenario
    ][s$runs, on = "scenario"][, `:=`(matrix = m, r0 = r0)]
  }))
}))
sizes[, matrix := factor(matrix, names(MATRICES))]
```

The three focal scenarios of Figure 4 for R0 = 5, 7, ..., 17 with the Epistorm-Mix contact matrix (`make sensitivity_epistorm`), against the same scenarios with the POLYMOD matrix of the main analysis (`make scenarios`, in `scenarios/`). Each scenario has 1,000 runs; runs with fewer than `r MIN_OUTBREAK_SIZE` cases are excluded as early extinctions. As in Figure 4, self-isolation with quarantine uses the run with quarantine and the other two scenarios the run without.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-epistorm
sizes[, cell := sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", fmt(median), fmt(q25), fmt(q75))]

tab <- dcast(
  sizes,
  r0 + scenario ~ matrix,
  value.var = c("retained", "cell")
)
setorder(tab, r0, scenario)

kable(
  tab[, .(
    r0, scenario,
    retained_POLYMOD, cell_POLYMOD,
    `retained_Epistorm-Mix`, `cell_Epistorm-Mix`
  )],
  col.names = c(
    "R0", "Scenario",
    "Retained runs, POLYMOD", "Infections, POLYMOD",
    "Retained runs, Epistorm-Mix", "Infections, Epistorm-Mix"
  ),
  align     = "rlrrrr",
  caption   = paste(
    "Final outbreak size at day 365, median (interquartile range) across",
    "the retained runs, by contact matrix."
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-si5
# Supplementary Table SI 5 compares the two contact matrices at R0 = 9.
# Simulations with fewer than 10 final cases are stochastic extinctions.
table_si5 <- sizes[r0 == 9, .(
  scenario,
  matrix,
  `Die out` = sprintf("%g%%", round(100 * (runs - retained) / runs, 1)),
  Median = fmt(median),
  IQR = sprintf("%s-%s", fmt(q25), fmt(q75))
)]
table_si5 <- dcast(
  table_si5,
  scenario ~ matrix,
  value.var = c("Die out", "Median", "IQR")
)
setcolorder(
  table_si5,
  c(
    "scenario",
    "Die out_POLYMOD", "Median_POLYMOD", "IQR_POLYMOD",
    "Die out_Epistorm-Mix", "Median_Epistorm-Mix", "IQR_Epistorm-Mix"
  )
)
setnames(
  table_si5,
  c(
    "Scenario",
    "POLYMOD mixing: % die out", "POLYMOD mixing: Median", "POLYMOD mixing: IQR",
    "Epistorm-Mix mixing: % die out", "Epistorm-Mix mixing: Median",
    "Epistorm-Mix mixing: IQR"
  )
)

kable(
  table_si5,
  align = "lrrrrrr",
  caption = paste(
    "Table SI 5. Comparison of final outbreak size at R0 = 9 from POLYMOD",
    "and Epistorm-Mix contact-matrix assumptions. Extinction is fewer than",
    "10 final cases; medians and interquartile ranges are across retained runs."
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-si6
# Supplementary Table SI 6 compares peak-incidence dates at R0 = 9. As in
# Table SI 4, each retained run contributes its first date of maximum daily
# incidence; the table summarizes those dates across runs.
PEAK_R0 <- 9
fmt_date <- function(x) format(x, "%m/%d/%Y")

peak_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(MATRICES), function(m) {
  s <- abm_summaries(
    MATRICES[[m]],
    PEAK_R0,
    epistorm = m == "Epistorm-Mix"
  )
  s$peak[, .(
    median = median(peak_date),
    q25 = as.Date(quantile(as.numeric(peak_date), 0.25, names = FALSE),
                  origin = "1970-01-01"),
    q75 = as.Date(quantile(as.numeric(peak_date), 0.75, names = FALSE),
                  origin = "1970-01-01")
  ), by = scenario][, matrix := m]
}))
peak_summary[, iqr := sprintf("%s-%s", fmt_date(q25), fmt_date(q75))]

table_si6 <- dcast(
  peak_summary,
  scenario ~ matrix,
  value.var = c("median", "iqr")
)
setcolorder(
  table_si6,
  c(
    "scenario",
    "median_POLYMOD", "iqr_POLYMOD",
    "median_Epistorm-Mix", "iqr_Epistorm-Mix"
  )
)
setnames(
  table_si6,
  c(
    "Scenario",
    "POLYMOD mixing: Median", "POLYMOD mixing: IQR",
    "Epistorm-Mix mixing: Median", "Epistorm-Mix mixing: IQR"
  )
)

for (column in c("POLYMOD mixing: Median", "Epistorm-Mix mixing: Median")) {
  set(table_si6, j = column, value = fmt_date(table_si6[[column]]))
}

kable(
  table_si6,
  align = "lrrrr",
  caption = paste(
    "Table SI 6. Comparison of peak-incidence dates at R0 = 9 from POLYMOD",
    "and Epistorm-Mix contact-matrix assumptions. Median and interquartile",
    "range are across runs with 10 or more cases."
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-epistorm
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-cap: "Final outbreak size at day 365 by R0 and contact matrix: median and interquartile range across the retained runs."
ggplot(sizes, aes(r0, median, color = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), size = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~matrix, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = SCENARIO_COLORS) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = R0_VALUES) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = "R0", y = "Infections") +
  theme_figure4() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = INK_PRIMARY))
```
